title: angelica daucoides
intro: Angelica daucoides, commonly known as Chinese angelica or dong quai, is a plant species in the parsley family that is native to Asia and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting women's reproductive health. The therapeutic actions of Chinese angelica include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Chinese angelica include coumarins, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
